response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the core mandatory requirements. C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 (plus a university thesis project), far short of the 5–10 years of hands-on C++ required, and there is no evidence of Windows-platform systems development. Database experience is centered on MongoDB and MySQL rather than SQL Server or Oracle, and there is no fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience — the closest adjacency is a fintech/investment product role at RIDE Capital built on Node/TypeScript/GraphQL. Strengths in testing, CI/CD, and communication are real but cannot offset the missing primary skill set.
strengths: Strong engineering fundamentals: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, low-latency systems
Proven communicator — conference talks, workshops, and courses
Broad polyglot experience across backend, embedded, and high-throughput services
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, over a decade ago
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain exposure
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development evidence
